input: Patil et al. (2023) report that Gorilla, a fine-tuned LLaMA model, writes API calls better than GPT-4 and largely avoids hallucinated API usage on APIBench, measured by matching the abstract syntax tree (AST) of the generated call against known APIs. Critique a claim that a low hallucination rate on this metric proves the generated API calls are functionally correct when executed.
source: Patil et al. 2023, Abstract and Conclusion (chunks patil2023-000, patil2023-025)
